Now this new job is better, but my health is another concern."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"You've really had a tough time, and it's impressive how you've managed to push through. It's okay to take things one step at a time."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks for saying that. I keep thinking about how my car breaking down was such a low point. It just felt like I couldn't catch a break."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That must have been incredibly difficult. It's understandable that these events would add up and make you feel stuck.
